name: Giraffe Raffe

categories.label: Could not play a card or apple (lost)
categories.hint: The player unable to take their turn loses; mark that player.

winCondition: No points. If a player cannot play cards to a tree or play an apple on their turn, they lose. Official text does not state who wins at 3+ players; reviews describe it as generating a loser rather than a single winner.

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player cannot take a turn.

notes: family: climbing-shedding. Official rulebook not obtained (BGG file download blocked); rules summary taken from publisher blurb, BoardGameArena help and a review. Solo mode vs giraffe robot not modelled. Winner definition for 3+ players and any multi-round scoring unverified.

sources.title: Giraffe Raffe - Board Game Arena help
